release_notes: Failed cloud recordings now stay encrypted on your PC with Retry and Discard, even after restarting Talkty. Choose a cloud backup in Settings: Qwen3 ASR Flash is the default, with other models and Off available. Temporary failures switch directly to a compatible backup; backup requests cost per use. Added Qwen3 ASR 1.7B as a separate option. Upgrading keeps your settings, history, saved recordings, models, and CUDA pack.
